title: Bus operators defend countrywide fare increases, cite
desc: Nsiimire said operators had reviewed fares following consultations across different regions, with western Uganda being the latest to adjust its rates.

title: Parkinson's disease linked to Agent Orange exposure
desc: Vietnam-era military veterans exposed to Agent Orange have a 57% greater risk of developing Parkinson's and related diseases compared with those who weren't exposed, according to new research that examined electronic health records covering millions of veterans.

title: Another oil price rollback set today
desc: Another fuel price rollback will greet motorists today following last week’s large price drop for gasoline.

title: Stocks plummet to lowest level in over 6 years
desc: It was a bloodbath in the local stock market yesterday, with the benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange index sinking to its lowest level in nearly six and a half years, or during the onslaught of the pandemic.

title: South Korea wants ‘closer solidarity’ with ASEAN
desc: South Korea wants to work with the Association of Southeast Asian Nations to develop artificial intelligence, promote cultural and creative industries and further strengthen its trade with the regional bloc.

title: UN chief urges faster renewable energy transition
desc: United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres yesterday called on countries to accelerate the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy and significantly increase climate financing for developing nations, warning that the worsening effects of global warming would further threaten vulnerable communities.

title: Jollibee rolling out 35 stores in Australia
desc: Asian food conglomerate Jollibee Foods Corp. is bringing its flagship brand Jollibee to Australia, with franchise agreements signed for 35 stores with an estimated investment of A$60 million or about P2.6 billion.

title: Surge of US datacenters adds equivalent of Denmark’s annual emissions, study finds
desc: ‘Hyperscaler’ datacenters across country draw upon dirtier power sources to meet vast energy needs, research shows

title: Best-case scenario for every College Football Playoff bubble team: Six teams vying for two at-large spots
desc: The field for the CFP is narrowing as we enter Week 12

title: Ken Urker’s Cause of Death Confirmed by Louisiana Coroner’s Office
desc: Police have confirmed the cause of death for Ken Urker, the boyfriend of Gypsy Rose Blanchard, who was found dead in a Louisiana home on Oct. 1.
